item.description:
**Description** AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
Humorphic Labs builds AI systems that work as teammates rather than tools. We ship them six months or more ahead of anyone else. The Lab is small on purpose so it can change direction in a day.
Humorphism concerns the quality of the working relationship between a person and an AI system. It asks whether the system acts proactively adapts to the person and the situation earns trust manages attention and strengthens human judgment. This role turns those behaviors into testable questions then answers them with working systems.
You will own the scientific agenda. You will convert a fuzzy behavioral goal into an end-to-end plan that covers data agent architecture evaluation and the product experiment that tests it. You will write code every week and build large parts of the experimental stack yourself because it does not exist yet.
The first focus areas are agentic products where a domain expert holds judgment the system cannot replace. Amazon Connect places an assistant beside a person handling a live conversation. AWS Bio Discovery places one beside a scientist running experiments. Both need evaluation that measures collaboration quality rather than task completion alone.
The role changes shape as the Lab matures. It starts as hands-on science in close partnership with product and engineering. Later it moves inside a product team to carry adoption of what the Lab proved.
Key job responsibilities
* Own the scientific strategy for human-AI collaboration across agentic and multimodal systems. * Convert desired interaction behaviors into falsifiable hypotheses evaluation tasks and system requirements. * Build the evaluation system that measures teammate behavior trust adaptation human contribution and failure recovery. * Design agent systems that use memory tools planning and recovery then test them with the people who do the work. * Design data collection and curation for language speech and interaction traces. * Build significant parts of the experimental stack yourself because that stack does not exist yet. * Diagnose failures across data models orchestration evaluation and product interaction. * Define the requirements engineering needs to turn a proven method into a product capability. * Partner with design product engineering and behavioral research from problem definition through product validation. * Run experiments with partner product teams then report what worked what failed and what changed as a result. * Set the standard for reproducible experiments evidence and scientific review inside the Lab. * Mentor scientists and engineers without moving away from hands-on work. * Represent the work in internal reviews and in appropriate external scientific venues.
A day in the life
Your week has two centers of gravity.
Most days you build. You take a claim about how a teammate should behave design the smallest experiment that can falsify it and run it. You read interaction traces from real sessions then argue with the engineers about what they mean.

The Position
**Principal Data Scientist - RDT Applied AI** Are you ready to use state-of-the-art AI to accelerate the journey of life-saving therapies from development to the patients who need them most?
Imagine acting as the bridge between cutting-edge machine learning and critical business strategy. We are looking for a visionary Principal Data Scientist to serve as a premier technical consultant to our business, providing critical advisory support to high-priority use cases across our Pharma Commercial and Product Research & Development (R&D) team. Rather than owning the day-to-day delivery of a single project, you will operate in a highly dynamic, cross-departmental landscape—acting as a strategic consultant across a broad portfolio of initiatives to guide multiple teams in transforming complex data into the predictive and generative engines that power our next generation of healthcare innovations.
**The Opportunity** The Principal Data Scientist - RDT Applied AI is a high-impact consulting role where advanced technical expertise meets business strategy in a highly regulated environment. Acting as an embedded consultant and strategic partner to our Pharma Commercial and Product R&D teams, you will guide the design and architecture of complex data science and AI solutions. You will evaluate commercial challenges, product development pipelines, and market dynamics to advise on sophisticated AI frameworks that drive measurable business value.
Crucially, you will act as a champion for Roche’s existing AI and data platforms. You will promote their re-use across the enterprise while simultaneously gathering insights from top-priority use cases to influence the strategic roadmap of these platforms, identifying tech gaps and new requirements.
This role requires deep expertise in advanced machine learning, generative AI, experimental design, and healthcare compliance. You will balance technical advisory with strategic leadership—shaping technical roadmaps, optimizing deployment strategies, and mentoring talent, all while advising senior business leaders on the art of the possible with AI in a regulated pharma environment.
